messages:
alex_k: Hey team — noticed my Q3 retention bonus was taxed in DE and again in US on payrun BR-8119 (2024-09-15). Net came in ~45% lower. Can someone verify? I moved residency 2024-08-29 and updated address + tax docs.

mina_payroll: hi @alex_k, can you paste the paystub lines (gross, tax lines) and confirm when you uploaded new tax form? no SSN please.

alex_k: paystub snippet: "Retention bonus gross: €6,500 / USD equiv: $7,000; DE wage tax: €1,950; US Fed withheld: $1,700; State OH withheld: $120; Net: $3,230" vendor = RemoteCo

payroll-bot: Payrun BR-8119 processed by RemoteCo on 2024-09-15T04:22:10Z. Residency flag changed to US effective 2024-08-29 in HR system. If discrepancy, open PO ticket.

trevor_finance: likely a timing mismatch — RemoteCo may have flagged the run region as DE due to run metadata. We'll need to check which tax authorities received payments and whether treaty relief applied.

tax-legal: @mina_payroll tagging: if DE PAYE already remitted, reclaim via Finanzamt may be needed or claim foreign tax credit on US return. We can assist with employee letter if required.

mina_payroll: I'll open vendor ticket RC-2042. Two options: (A) off-cycle reversal + reissue under US payroll; (B) file reclaim with German vendor and apply foreign tax credit later. Reissue is faster if vendor can reverse.

alex_k: I prefer reversal + reissue. Can sign consent. also, what about year-end reporting? will this split affect my final forms?

trevor_finance: yes we'll need to reconcile for W-2 and DE Jahreslohnsteuerbescheinigung. Document will note reversal so auditors can match. If reversal spans tax year, we may need amended forms.

mina_payroll: consent form link: https://hr.redwoodinference/payroll-discrepancy — please choose "reissue" and include last4 of bank for re-deposit.

alex_k: submitted form (last4 9876) — signed now.

remoteco-support: RC-2042 acknowledged 2024-09-16T10:12Z. Vendor requests signed PDF consent and clarification whether to reverse DE PAYE prior to remittance window. Turnaround 3 business days after consent.

mina_payroll: collected consent, sent to RemoteCo. PO-2207 opened to track. I'll ping vendor for expedited reversal.

trevor_finance: if vendor can't reclaim PAYE before remittance, we'll do reissue and then chase reclaim — may take 6-10 weeks.

alex_k: thanks. any temporary cash advance option if reissue delayed?

mina_payroll: we can approve an emergency payroll advance up to net amount; submit request here: https://hr.redwoodinference/pay-advance (cc @trevor_finance). We'll confirm within 48 hours.

alex_k: requested advance. thanks for quick help.

mina_payroll: noted. keeping thread open, will post vendor updates and PO-2207 status. :white_check_mark:
